title: Multi-task neural network predicts cervical cancer stage, histology, grade, nodes
summary: A multi-task artificial neural network trained on 223 retrospectively enrolled cervical cancer cases predicted stage, histology, grade and lymph node metastasis from preoperative clinical information. On a prospectively collected independent set of 58 cases, accuracies were 75%, 95%, 86% and 76%. Except for lymph node metastasis, it beat single-task models, 20 gynecologists and AI-assisted doctors. The validation set is small and from one hospital.
ai_technology: Multi-task learning artificial neural network on preoperative clinical information
organization: Beijing Friendship Hospital, Capital Medical University; Maastricht University Medical Centre+

evidence.tested: Retrospective training (n = 223), an independent prospective validation set (n = 58) and a Turing test with 20 gynecologists.
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger multi-center cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts four clinical-pathological features at once from preoperative data.
